args.text: [lane-stoat] Risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Users may be sent to an old server address after a site moves, causing outages. (2) Fast failover is slowed, because traffic keeps going to a broken server until the cache expires. (3) A forged or poisoned answer stays in the cache longer, so harm lasts longer. Lifetime figures: unknown.

[lane-stoat] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail in ways that leave us unsure whether a request worked, so we must be able to send it again. If the request is idempotent (repeating it gives the same result as doing it once), a retry cannot cause double charges or duplicate records.
